channel.title: For Her on Madhav's Site
channel.description: Recent content in For Her on Madhav's Site

item.title: Beat Yourself Up
item.description:
You beat yourself up too much for your own good, baby.

You’re soo cool and soo precious to everyone. A lot of people love you lots.

Me included :P

Btw, I hope you noticed these songs are in chronological order, heard as I’ve spent these two months with you.

Thanks for being here, thanks for staying.

Love you lots, princess

back

item.title: Big Talk
item.description:
Okay, now this is the first song I’ve really, REALLY felt as though is ours.

I heard this first when I was playing fifa mobile ‘23 andd just liked the beat anddd when I met you, and heard it again - I listened to the lyrics, and it just captured us at that time.

It’s always just a good song until you.

How you meant to fall if you won’t get deep?

item.title: Blueberry Faygo
item.description:
This was always just a good song until you started liking it.

I first understood how much you affected or had an influence on me when I started listening to this song more and more since you let me know you liked it a lot.

This also has absolutely no good lyrics - but atleast the beat’s catchy

\_(0_0)_/

back

item.title: Cry
item.description:
Umm, this song was from the last charlie puth album andd I was pretty excited for it but only like 3 good songs :(

But these songs are good, andd sometimes it’s okay to cry, you know? You don’t have to carry all of it by yourself.

I’m at your service, my princess.

back

item.title: Go Again
item.description:
No playlist of us will be complete without this song.

There isn’t much in the lyrics except the fact that I would infact go again just to be a better person for you and myself.

It’s nice to see where we were and where we are now :P

back

item.title: Maahive
item.description:
I think you already know that this song is what I’ve associated my summer vacations with when I was younger.

Also I’m fucking obsessed with the panning modulation of the claps every like 16 bars or smth.

I’m kinda obsessed with you too, and this song is in hindi so naturally you’re the only one who comes to mind.

back

item.title: Monta Re
item.description:
Believe it or not, it was achu who mentioned this song before I added it to my playlist, and obviously it’s very yearning and blah blah BUT you said it was the best yearning song - and since you’re the best-est person ever, it’s a regular playlist listen.

And obviously I think of you, idiot.

back

item.title: Rangapura Vihara
item.description:
I first listened to agam when a friend of mine said “DOOD THIS IS SO COOL JUST LISTEN TO IT”, and fell in love ever since.

It also reminds me of the walk I took from kowdiar to nishagandhi cus I was playing this on the IEMs then - I was giddy and excited andd I was just so happy to see you.

Also you gotta wait for the drums in this songg so I did get the idea that it was good to wait for something good from this song - especially after I met you.

item.title: Sakhiye
item.description:
This is a song by my friends from kochi, andd I don’t really listen to it’s lyrics, but the production just makes me think about you. The guitars and the soft presence of the drums just make me giddy anddd veryyy much in love hehehe.

back

item.title: Sita Kalyanam
item.description:
This song is all you, love.

There’s nothing more to explain.

Every second of it, all I think about is you.

back
